[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lyon is renowned for its gastronomy and has a plethora of delicious restaurants serving traditional Lyonnaise cuisine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants in Lyon include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. La Mère Poulard (14, rue du Garet, 69001 Lyon) - famous for salade lyonnaise and quenelles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Daniel et Denise (36, rue Tramassac, 69005 Lyon) - Michelin-starred restaurant offering refined Lyonnaise cuisine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. L'Auberge du Pont de Collonges (40, rue de la Plage, 69660 Collonges-au-Mont-d'Or) - three-Michelin-starred restaurant known for poulet de Bresse.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended bouchons in Lyon include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Le Garet (7, rue du Garet, 69001 Lyon) - classic bouchon with dishes like tarte aux pralines and cervelas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Le Kitchen Café (19, rue des Remparts d'Ainay, 69002 Lyon) - cozy bouchon with creative dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Chez Hugon (12, rue Pizay, 69001 Lyon) - traditional bouchon since 1924.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended modern and innovative restaurants in Lyon include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. L'Équipe (25, rue de la Bourse, 69002 Lyon) - trendy restaurant focusing on seasonal ingredients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Le Neuvième Art (25, rue du Premier-Film, 69001 Lyon) - modern bistro with artistic presentation.
